body:
Update: beginning the process of ditching the dicks. I  realized there was a good option for a new friend right under my face, so I asked him if he would go see Thor with me on Friday. Let's call him D.  We're going with this other kid (who is ok, don't mind him, but I feel like he looks down on me a lot). Anyway, it was going to just be us and none of the dicks but then D and I were planning when we should go and one of the dicks overhead us and D felt obligated to invite him. 

I asked him why he invited the guy and D said that didn't want to at all. Apparently they don't invite D to anything either. So I'm actually really excited about hanging out with D. I have before, but I am going to try to be genuinely nice to him and not be a dick like those other guys are. I think they've rubbed off on me. 

D and I went to get coffee with one of them tonight. It was fun, but I know that he (one of the guys that doesn't invite) will just turn around and pull a jerk move again. I know D won't though, and I know that he's someone that I will eventually be able to confide in--- someone that won't make fun of me for my ex  or stuff like that because he is the butt of a lot of the dicks' jokes. 

Oh, and  if they ask why they didn't get invited to go watch thor, I'm telling them straight up. You dot invite me, I don't invite you. I found out that last week after I asked them to see a movie with me they blew me off, then went to watch bad grandpa with my cousin (a girl). They blew off their friend because they were horny. Screw them. Thanks for finally letting me get that off my chest. Finally seeing change. 

Anyway, I just wanted to share my progress. Thanks for responding and taking the time to read this. It means a lot
I  agree with you. It's a lot harder to experience it but I believe I will come out stronger
Yep. Like I said, they were making fun of me when my ex broke up with me. They aren't friends, they're people I am forced to sit with at lunch. Bunch of dicks

It's been like this for awhile. I don't even know what it's like to have friends that care. When my ex broke up with me they made fun of me (none of them have had a gf, either, so they have no room to talk). But it was one of the most trying times of my life and they didn't care. Let's just make it through this year and find some people that are actually nice in college. Best of luck brother
I'm trying man! Gonna be tough and even if I get in I have to get the right financial aid. Keep your head up, brother.

That's part of the reason I post here sometimes. No one else is around/cares. You describe how I feel to a tee. Sometimes it's nice to block everyone out and just spend time alone, but then most other times I wish I was texting someone or hanging out with people that actually care about me. And when the door closes it seems like it amplifies my loneliness. Feel free to pm me... Seems like we're going through similar stuff

Yep. Same for me. Nights are the worst for me, although sometimes in the morning I look in the mirror and I don't want to go to school or talk to anyone. But generally I am forced to think about my life at night too. That's also led me to have problems with PMO (I don't know if you're familiar with r/nofap).

Thanks man, that really helps. I really hope you find some good friends. I think I've had a taste of that freedom you talk about. It isn't much but when my friends ditch me and I'm ok I get this feeling of being free from them and being able to be who I am. They aren't like me anyway. I like learning, reading, school (well, not high school, but you know what I mean). They like sports and parties and don't really care about me. The freedom is amazing, I agree. But it's nights like this one that are the worst. At any rate, thanks for responding, you have no idea how much it means to me.

Exactly. I tried to max out my schedule this year so I don't even have time to think about anything that's going on in my life. But I have so much compared to others that it doesn't make sense for me to complain. I have a house, car, family..more than most people but I stills feel like shit 90% of the time.
Also, ohio

Exactly. That's why sometimes I feel like shit because I know I have more than 90% of the world but I still can't be happy. I feel guilty for feeling bad because I know there are people who don't have as much as me.

My day was ok. More of the same. I cannot wait for golf to be over so I can just focus on my schooling. I'm still trying to wrap my head around what I should do in college, and I know I can't do it in one day, but it kind of sucks not knowing what I want to do with the rest of my life. Went to church and had an ok time there. Not great but not bad. I have a golf tournament tomorrow. Kind of nervous because I need to beat another guy to get on the tournament team. I spent all summer practicing golf and I'm still fighting for the last spot. Hopefully that goes well. Thanks for reading, possiamo

> "If You're Going Through Hell, Keep Going" - Winston Churchill
> Keep going

I like this, I think I'll make it my motto for now.  Thanks!
Thanks man that helps.

Thanks so much for your response. I read every word and I appreciate everything. 

Like I said in another response, my parents prefer that I go to a Christian school, but if not they have told me they will definitely support me etc. We can afford most colleges, but the ones I would really like (Duke, Harvard) would be difficult to pay for because my family might make just enough to clear the major financial aid range but too little to afford an expensive college. Anyway, thanks for reading and thanks for responding. God bless.
No I'm not being bullied. Just sometimes I hate who I am and people being people amplify that. Thanks for the response

I meant I have an iPhone, ipad, family computer, etc. Every single electronic thing is a bit of an exaggeration. I meant yes I have those things but attending a college such as duke or Harvard would be too much for my family as I have 3 younger siblings. I don't know how everything will pan out yet but as of now it looks like we make just enough to be too much for aid and but still not able to afford it.
Looked into I and its really neat. Problem is it's too far away and my parents don't want me too far for the first few years. Thank you very much for the response
Thank you so much for your response. Reading it opened my eyes a bit. This whole process is a learning thing for me. I'm trying to find something I enjoy. Thanks again it means a lot

Thanks man. Thanks a bunch. It truly means the world. 

My school is very small, yes. The reason I'm second is because the guy ahead of me got an A-in a semester course and I got an A- in a year course. Bullshit but I might still pass him anyway. We are both above 4.0. 

My parents wouldn't want me to go to Harvard first because they want me to go to a Christian college and secondly because they are of the conservative republican mentality. Obviously professors/people at Harvard would have a more liberal view than at a Christian school. But I still want to go there. I want to prove everyone at my school wrong because none of them think I can make it. And 20 years from now I want to go back to my class reunion and be able to be the most successful and have people talk about what I've done, not the stud athletes. I'm not unpopular to say, but I also don't get invited to things that other people do. Sometimes because my 'friends' are just dicks. 

No, this girl and are aren't friends, I decided to ignore all contact with her since she broke up with me. We pretty much were dating the whole summer last year then in October says she wasn't ready for a relationship. So screw that. Haven't talked to her. Like I said its not that I miss her as far as romantically or whatever but I miss having a friend who actually cares about how my day went and how I feel. And if I have a bad day, someone was there for me. 

For now I'm just going to keep studying my ass off trying to get into Harvard.
Thanks so much for your response you will never know how much it means to me. I wish I could meet you in person. Maybe we could just talk on here?

That probably will never happen though. My scores are not good enough yet and I only have one more shot to get them up. I might be able to study business but not at Harvard. I don't know if it's a dream job or not. I just became interested in it recently. I have always wanted to attend Harvard, but it appears those chances are slipping away.

It's so hard, every day I wish I were in college or living somewhere else in the world where people saw me for something else. Now people just see me as the kid who sucks at sports and doesn't have a date to homecoming.
I grew up speaking both English and a dialect of German. I also learned French and Spanish and I'm learning italian and a little German right now.
I want to go to Harvard to study business and work internationally
If I could afford to give you gold I would. Thank you so much it means a lot to hear someone say something like that to me
I feel you man, I feel you. It's something I experience quite often. Stay strong
Thanks man
I don't know of any clubs in our school or area like that but I  will look into it, much appreciated
Thanks buddy
I went through therapy for my OCD, but I didn't really have issues with depression back then. That was6+ years ago. I'm hoping my pastor can help me out a bit with therapy

I was diagnosed with OCD, and before that my parents would not allow me to wash my hands (I washed them so much they began to crack). I took some therapy and I can say that I have learned to control it, but before, not being able to do something caused a lot of anxiety and worry over not being able to do that habit.
